verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents its own single sign-on across SAML and OIDC apps, which covers the 'sign in once' part of the story. The evidence never shows an employee-facing launcher portal, an app catalog of assigned apps, or a browser extension. missing for 10: a user portal or launcher dashboard listing assigned apps, a browser extension, evidence that apps are shown per user assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, one portal holds my work apps — a launcher dashboard (and browser extension) where I sign in once and reach everything I'm assigned

citations.quote: Enforce SSO and multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all SAML and OIDC-based apps.
